tokens.name: ground-window
tokens.usage: The ground of Classic's panel beside the photograph and of every window. Two greys: equal to ground-page on Apple and Numa Home. Linux keeps libadwaita's own window ground (#222226 dark).

tokens.name: ground-view
tokens.usage: The ground of lists and the library grid. Two greys: equal to ground-page on Apple and Numa Home. Linux keeps libadwaita's view ground.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: A stand-in print while no thumbnail exists, a card, a raised tile (Show All). Two greys: equal to ground-chip. Linux draws libadwaita's raised grey (#2e2e32 dark). Text on it is name or ink, never label.

tokens.name: ground-sheet
tokens.usage: The iPhone editor's sheet and the sheets it opens, radius-sheet on top. Two greys: equal to ground-page.

tokens.name: ground-page
tokens.usage: Every page on the iPhone and the iPad: Libraries, a library's grid (Apple `Numa.page`). Also the dark text on a white accent (see on-accent). Light chosen: #ffffff.

tokens.name: ground-photo
tokens.usage: Behind the photograph, in every editor: iPhone, Classic and Modern (Apple `Numa.photo`). Stays black in the light theme too, because photographs are judged against a dark surround; Linux light currently draws darker(@window_bg_color) behind the canvas.

tokens.name: ground-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, command buttons and round buttons at rest (Apple `Numa.chip`: ChipStyle, CommandStyle, RoundStyle). Light #e8e8e8 chosen. `label` fails 4.5:1 here; chip text is white.

tokens.name: ground-hud
tokens.usage: Modern's floating panels and the value HUD: #141414 at 55% over a thin material (Apple `Numa.hud`), a 12px backdrop blur on the web. Lowered from 0.78 at the photographer's request in build 31: "van mij mag het ook wat lager, zichtbaarheid is wel heel belangrijk" — visibility still comes first, so the material does the reading work and text over it is `name` or white, not `label`. Same in both themes: it sits on the photograph.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, and a touched slider's name and value (Linux `.touched`, Apple `.white`). Dark: 15.5:1 on ground-window, 17.2:1 on ground-sheet. Light: libadwaita's window_fg (renders #323237 on ground-window, 12:1).

tokens.name: name
tokens.usage: A slider's name at rest (Linux `.slider-name`, Apple `Numa.name`), secondary buttons like Cancel. Dark: 8.3:1 on ground-window, 9.2:1 on ground-sheet, 7.0:1 on ground-raised. Light #3d3d3d chosen (10.4:1 on ground-window); the Linux light scheme still paints #bdbdbd, which fails there.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Section labels, a value at rest, captions and meta lines. 4.7:1 or more on ground-page and ground-photo; FAILS on ground-chip and ground-raised (4.32:1): text there is name. More contrast (Apple Increase Contrast, Linux high contrast) raises it to the `contrast` value, #b4b4b4 dark, #3d3d3d light.

tokens.name: intro-word
tokens.usage: The wordmark 'numa' in the eclipse intro (prototype #e8e8e8; PhoneIntro white 0.91). 15:1 on the intro ground.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline between panel and photograph and under bars (Linux alpha(currentColor, 0.1), Apple `Numa.rule`). Light: the same 10% of ink. High contrast (Linux) and Increase Contrast (Apple) raise it one step to `contrast`; the photograph's side keeps the dark value.

tokens.name: rule-sheet
tokens.usage: The line above the iPhone's tab row (PhoneEditor). High contrast (Linux) and Increase Contrast (Apple) raise it one step to `contrast`; the photograph's side keeps the dark value.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The slider's 2px hairline track, at rest and touched alike (Linux `.adjustment scale trough`, Apple, both prototypes). Light: 11% of ink, chosen.

tokens.name: track-hover
tokens.usage: The slider's track under a pointer, Linux and the Mac. Linux's map in the light scheme also draws its major roads in it (map_view.rs).

tokens.name: thumb-rest
tokens.usage: The slider's dot on its neutral: 0.36 on every device, for 3:1 on the ground (panel spec, 29 October); in a panel card the dot at rest is `label` (SliderLook.restDot; Linux `scale slider`).

tokens.name: rest-tick
tokens.usage: The 1x8 tick marking a moved slider's rest (NumaSlider).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Numa's accent: white, as the mark (Apple `Numa.accent`). A chosen chip or tab, a prominent command (Done), a round button that is on, held Before, a moved slider's fill and dot, focus ring. Replaces libadwaita blue #3584e4, retired as Numa's accent. Light theme: inverted to ground-page's #141414 (chosen) since white cannot show on white; still monochrome.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill: a chosen chip or tab, Done, an on round button, a held Before (Apple `Numa.onAccent`, #141414). 18.4:1 on accent in both themes.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: A rejected frame: its cross, its stars, the reject flag's fill (Linux `.rejected`, Apple `Numa.reject`). Dark: 6.1:1 on ground-window, 7.6 on ground-photo, 5.2 on ground-raised. Light #c01c28 chosen (GNOME palette Red 4, 5.9:1 on ground-window); #ff7a66 on a light ground is 2.5:1 and fails.

tokens.name: star-rest
tokens.usage: An unset star's outline over the photograph on the iPhone (PhonePhoto, white 0.37). FAILS 3:1 for a meaningful icon: 2.98:1 on ground-photo. Kept exact from the code; flagged.

tokens.name: mask-wash
tokens.usage: The red wash over what a mask covers, times the mask's strength (Linux masks.rs and Apple's numa-ffi masks.rs: rgb 0.95 0.3 0.3 at 0.4). Same in both themes: it is painted on the photograph, and must be a colour no photograph is.

tokens.name: mask-erase
tokens.usage: A brush stroke that rubs a mask out (Linux draw_stroke).

tokens.name: clip-shadow
tokens.usage: The histogram's clipped-shadows light (Linux `.clip-shadow`). A signal colour, not an accent.

tokens.name: clip-highlight
tokens.usage: The histogram's clipped-highlights light (Linux `.clip-highlight`).

tokens.name: ground-photo-card-linux
tokens.usage: The PhotoCard and pill ground on Linux, where GTK cannot blur what is behind (style.css `.photo-card`: ground-page at 0.7). Apple and Numa Home use ground-hud over a material or a 12px blur.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Needs your action: a mark on the one thing (a device row, a stalled library, a backup that stopped), always beside words that say what and at most one action. Never a fill, never a banner's ground, never for errors that are only information. Moved from #e0b04a to #ff9f43 on 6 November 2026 (UX-082) so it does not clash with `star`. Dark 9.0:1 on ground-page, 7.0:1 on ground-chip; light #a14f00 5.8:1 on white, 4.7:1 on ground-chip. Decided 18 October 2026 (7A), on all six clients.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: The pick flag, on a thumbnail, in the bar and in a filter chip: a small glyph or text only, never a fill. Signal colour (UX-082, 6 November 2026, direction 1): white stays the accent, signals carry meaning on small marks. Dark 10.6:1 on ground-page, 8.2:1 on ground-chip; light #267544 5.7:1 on white, 4.6:1 on ground-chip.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: A set star: the glyph on thumbnails, in the rating bar and in the loupe, and a star count in text. Glyph and text only. The unset star keeps `star-rest`; a rejected frame keeps `reject`. Dark 11.2:1 on ground-page, 8.7:1 on ground-chip; light #865f0b 5.7:1 on white, 4.7:1 on ground-chip.

tokens.name: edited
tokens.usage: The edited dot on a thumbnail and in the filmstrip, and the word Edited: a 6px dot or text only. Dark 8.5:1 on ground-page, 6.6:1 on ground-chip; light #6a39ff 5.8:1 on white, 4.7:1 on ground-chip.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information that asks nothing of you: the info glyph, a neutral notice, a link-like hint. Glyph and text only, never a fill; an alert that needs action is `attention`. Distinct from the histogram's clip-shadow blue, which is a signal on the photograph and stays. Dark 9.1:1 on ground-page, 7.1:1 on ground-chip; light #005be8 5.7:1 on white, 4.7:1 on ground-chip.

tokens.name: ground-bar
tokens.usage: Numa Home's bar on the web, under a 12px backdrop blur. The native clients keep their platform's bars.

tokens.name: surround-black
tokens.usage: Surround (P17): black behind the photograph. Numa Home also uses it at 0.62 under a tile's marks. The Surround choice itself is not built yet.

tokens.name: surround-dark
tokens.usage: Surround (P17): the default, the same as ground-photo.

tokens.name: surround-grey
tokens.usage: Surround (P17): middle grey, L* 50, for judging brightness. Not built yet on any client.

tokens.name: surround-light
tokens.usage: Surround (P17): light grey, L* 80. Not built yet on any client.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: The map (album trip maps and Numa Home's Places): land. Dark only: Linux's light map draws from ground-sheet, ground-chip, rule, track-hover, label and name (map_view.rs); Numa Home reads `--map-*`.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: The map: water, ground-photo, a step darker than land.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: The map: roads.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: The map: major roads.

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: The map: borders, as rule.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: The map: labels, as label.

tokens.name: map-label-place
tokens.usage: The map: names of places, as name.

families.system: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "Adwaita Sans", Cantarell, system-ui, sans-serif
families.apple: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The platform's own face: SF Pro on Apple, Adwaita Sans (Cantarell before libadwaita 1.7) on Linux. Sizes in px/pt from the sources; line heights are not set in any source and were chosen here.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name over the photograph of the day on Today (Linux, Numa Home `.today-hero .title`, Apple `Numa.type.display`).

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: A page's title: Libraries, a library's name (iPhone prototype h1 32/700; SwiftUI's .large navigation title on device). Line height chosen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A shelf's heading (PhoneLibraries 'Folders' 20 bold). Line height chosen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A print stack's name, a HUD-less row's name on iPad rails (15). Line height chosen.

styles.name: bar
styles.usage: Bar buttons on iPhone: Cancel, Done (Done at 600). Line height chosen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Explanations and empty states in label colour (PhoneLibraries 13). Line height chosen.
styles.sample: A folder of photographs from Files, RAW files too, as a library of its own.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip and pill labels, Linux panel-action and PillStyle (13 semibold). Line height = the chip's 32px height.

styles.name: slider-name
styles.usage: A slider's name; the section's lead at 600 (Linux `.slider-name`, NumaSlider). Line height chosen.

styles.name: slider-value
styles.usage: A slider's readout, always tabular figures (`tnum` / .monospacedDigit()) so it does not jitter while dragging.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: The small grey spaced section label, uppercase (Linux `.section-header`, SwiftUI SectionLabel: 10, semibold, tracking 1.1). Line height chosen.

styles.name: hud-name
styles.usage: The HUD's name, uppercase, in label (iPad prototype 12/600/+1.1).

styles.name: hud-value
styles.usage: The HUD's number, light, tabular (iPad prototype 26/300). The wheel's dial uses 30/300.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A stack's caption, tabular (PhoneLibraries 12 monospaced digits).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: A photograph's EXIF line and star badges on thumbnails (11).

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Under a tab icon (iPhone tab row 10, Linux `.rail-label` 10; iPad rail 10.5/600).

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk (Google Fonts, SIL OFL 1.1), used only for the word 'numa' in lowercase, wide-tracked, at 300.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The word 'numa' under the mark in the eclipse intro: 0.38em tracking at rest, drawing in from 0.9em (prototype). Lowercase always. Hanken Grotesk 300, as PhoneIntro.swift sets it (the variable file bundled, wght 300).

spacing.note: A strict 4 pt grid since 28 October 2026 (Numa-mac docs/DESIGN_APPLE_2026.md §2; dev/style.py counts what is off it): every padding, gap, size and radius a multiple of 4, except hairlines (1), the 2 pt track, the iPhone grid gap (2) and the measured signatures (slider row 46, dot 10/14, print 118x104), each marked. Before: "5px stays 5px".

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The iPhone photo grid's gap (three columns, 2px).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between rail tabs (Linux), the thumb margin math, small nudges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (28 October 2026): off the 4 pt grid. Kept so generated stylesheets still resolve; new work uses the nearest multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row; the rail's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (28 October 2026): off the 4 pt grid. Kept so generated stylesheets still resolve; new work uses the nearest multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a print stack and its name; loupe padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (28 October 2026): off the 4 pt grid. Kept so generated stylesheets still resolve; new work uses the nearest multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bar and chip-row side inset on iPhone.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (28 October 2026): off the 4 pt grid. Kept so generated stylesheets still resolve; new work uses the nearest multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page gutter on iPhone; the sheet's slider inset.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (28 October 2026): off the 4 pt grid. Kept so generated stylesheets still resolve; new work uses the nearest multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between big blocks; an empty state.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target on iPhone and iPad (Apple HIG; every button in the prototypes). Also the gap between the mark and the word in the intro.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: A page margin on the Mac and iPad.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: A hero's air.

tokens.name: slider-row
tokens.usage: A slider row's minimum height, every platform (Linux `.slider-row`, NumaSlider).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The one outer margin: every element at a screen edge (Modern's corner bar, rail, strip, bottom row; floating controls) sits this far from the edge, or the safe inset if larger. The photographer: 'goed plan van je 16pt'.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Between neighbouring floating elements (Modern's cards and the strip, the round buttons of a row).

radius.note: Photographs keep small corners; controls round off; nothing is square except the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: The 2px slider track and its fill.

tokens.name: radius-tick
tokens.usage: A tick, a clip corner (Apple `Numa.radius.tick`).

tokens.name: radius-histogram
tokens.usage: The histogram and tone curve wells on Linux (Apple uses 6).

tokens.name: radius-print
tokens.usage: A print in a stack, a thumbnail, a preset card, a face: 8 on every client. Linux's album tiles still draw 6 (style.css `.album-tile`).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Linux-style segmented rows. Apple's command button (CommandStyle, formerly PillStyle) is a capsule now, not this radius. (7 before.)

tokens.name: radius-action
tokens.usage: A panel action button (Linux `.panel-action`), the mask scope line.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Library cards on Linux and the Linux rail tab. (10 before the 4 pt grid.)

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: A 32px chip, Before on iPhone: half its height, a capsule.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The iPhone editor sheet's top corners. (18 before.)

tokens.name: radius-hud
tokens.usage: The value HUD, Modern's panels on the photograph and the 44 round buttons. Linux's `.value-hud` still draws 22.

tokens.name: radius-photo-card
tokens.usage: The PhotoCard on the photograph (histogram, Numa did). Pills on the photograph are full capsules. Linux still draws 14 (style.css `.photo-card`).

shadow.note: Only prints and the intro's light cast shadows; controls are flat (UX-014 took the handle shadow away).

tokens.name: shadow-print-front
tokens.usage: The front print of a stack (prototype; Swift radius 10, y 8, black 0.6).

tokens.name: shadow-print-back
tokens.usage: The two prints behind it (Swift radius 8, y 6, black 0.55).

tokens.name: shadow-intro-glow
tokens.usage: The light disc's glow at its peak in the intro (35% of the glow).

tokens.name: shadow-intro-rest
tokens.usage: The light disc's glow settled, the last frame of the intro and its reduced-motion frame.

tokens.name: shadow-badge
tokens.usage: Star text over a thumbnail (prototype text-shadow).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus in Numa's own content: a solid 2px accent ring 2px out (prototypes: outline 2px #fff, offset 2px). Chrome uses the platform's own focus ring.

size.note: Fixed sizes that make the signatures recognisable.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: The slider's hairline track and its fill.

tokens.name: dot-panel
tokens.usage: The slider dot on Linux and iPad (SliderLook.dot 10).

tokens.name: dot-phone
tokens.usage: The slider dot on iPhone (14, monochrome).

tokens.name: tick-rest
tokens.usage: Height of the 1px rest tick on a moved slider.

tokens.name: print-width
tokens.usage: One print in a stack (118 x 104).

tokens.name: print-height
tokens.usage: One print in a stack.

tokens.name: stack-width

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: A chip, Before on iPhone.

tokens.name: rail-tab

tokens.name: mark-intro

tokens.name: mark-bar

tokens.name: hit-touch
